title: Mobile Bottom Navigation Drag Snapback Fix & Direct Gesture Decoupling
summary: Eliminates mid-drag indicator snapback on the mobile bottom navigation bar by removing premature vertical bounds cancellation and decoupling 120fps direct DOM transforms from React JSX render reconciliation.

changes.text: Mobile Bottom Dock Drag Snapback: eliminated vertical out-of-bounds cancellation that prematurely snapped the indicator back to the starting tab during natural upward thumb arcing.

Render Diffing Decoupling: decoupled thumb indicator transforms from React JSX style reconciliation via useLayoutEffect, guaranteeing that component re-renders on tab crossings never wipe out or reset active DOM transforms.
Immediate Drag Tracking: removed vertical scroll intent abort checks on the touch-none dock, allowing horizontal thumb tracking to begin immediately upon slight touch movement.
Initial Tab Detection: mapped touchstart coordinates directly to the touched tab's bounding box instead of assuming activeIndex.
